name: Eloy
literature_vertical_cm_per_yr: >7 cm/yr in localized active zones; Arizona maxima up to ~12 cm/yr (2005-2014); ongoing ADWR Radarsat-2 monitoring (2025-2026)
literature_sources: Arizona Department of Water Resources (ADWR), Total land subsidence in the Eloy sub-basin (March 2025 - March 2026), https://www.azwater.gov/sites/default/files/2026-05/PicachoArea03-2025to03-2026_8x11.pdf
agreement_note: Consistent in order of magnitude: 120-day summer NISAR signal (-8.0 cm LOS, -10.3 cm vertical est., -6.7 cm/100d) aligns with localized active Picacho/Eloy drawdown (>7-12 cm/yr). Passed time-series QC, high spatial coherence (69.6% valid pixels), tight reference spread [-8.4, -7.2] cm (ratio 0.15).
press_summary_gate_note: Approved for atlas #4 rank (passed tools/atlas_qc.py, high confidence, tight reference spread 0.15).
quality_note: NISAR data are provisional. Calibration and validation are carried out by the NISAR project (NASA-JPL and ISRO), not by our team.
